meta.description: Provisional privacy policy describing how Urugo handles user information during platform development.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: A plain-language overview of how Urugo plans to collect and use information across our public site and rental dashboards.
privacy.provisionalNote: Provisional notice: This Privacy Policy is a working draft for the current product preview and requires formal legal review before general public release.

about.heading: About Urugo
about.p1: Urugo is a rental housing platform designed to help people find homes in Rwanda and help landlords list properties or manage rentals from move-in to move-out.

info.heading: Information You Provide
info.p1: When you create an account, list a property, request a viewing, send an inquiry, or manage a lease on Urugo, you may enter details such as your name, phone number, email address, property details, and rental records.
info.p2: During the current frontend preview stage, several interactions are stored locally in your browser so you can test workflows. Live backend storage, authentication, and notification services will be covered by the final reviewed policy before public launch.

use.heading: How Information Is Intended to Be Used
use.p1: Information entered on Urugo is intended to connect home seekers with landlords, schedule property viewings, keep lease and payment records organized, and support rental history reviews.
use.p2: Landlords using Urugo can choose whether to display their phone number, WhatsApp contact, or email address on public listings.

sharing.heading: Sharing and Visibility
sharing.p1: Public property details such as location, rent, photos, and amenities are visible to anyone browsing Urugo. Contact details and private rental records are intended only for the relevant landlord, renter, or authorized platform support staff once backend access controls are active.

choices.heading: Your Choices
choices.p1: You can browse public listings without creating an account. For preview data stored in your browser, you can clear your browser storage at any time. Once live accounts launch, you will be able to update or request deletion of your account information.

meta.title: Terms of Service (Provisional)
meta.description: Provisional terms of service for home seekers, landlords, and renters using the Urugo platform.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Clear, straightforward expectations for home seekers, landlords, and renters using Urugo.
terms.provisionalNote: Provisional notice: These Terms of Service are a working draft for the current product preview and require formal legal review before general public release.

scope.heading: Scope of Urugo
scope.p1: Urugo provides tools for searching rental properties, connecting home seekers with landlords, and helping landlords either advertise listings (Listing-Only mode) or manage leases, rent payment records, and tenancies (Full Rental Management).
scope.p2: Urugo is a software platform and is not a party to rental contracts between landlords and renters.

landlord.heading: Landlord Responsibilities
landlord.p1: Landlords who list properties on Urugo are responsible for providing accurate descriptions, photos, pricing, and availability status.
landlord.p2: Listing-Only landlords manage their own viewing schedules, agreements, and rent collection independently. Managed landlords remain responsible for verifying payments and following applicable local rental laws.

renter.heading: Home Seeker and Renter Responsibilities
renter.p1: Home seekers should inspect properties in person and confirm lease terms directly with the landlord before paying any deposit or rent.
renter.p2: Renters using Urugo's rental management tools are responsible for submitting accurate payment references and communicating repair requests or balance disputes in good faith.

history.heading: Rental History and Disputes
history.p1: Any rental balance notice logged on Urugo is intended to give renters a clear notice window to settle or dispute the record with supporting proof before it is confirmed.

preview.heading: Preview Status and Changes
preview.p1: Parts of Urugo's frontend currently run in preview mode using sample data while backend services are being connected. Features and these provisional terms may change prior to full public launch.

replies.landlordContent:
Urugo supports two landlord service paths on the same account:

• Listing-Only: Publish properties with photos, prices, and availability, and handle inquiries and viewings yourself.
• Full Rental Management: Add tenants, leases, mobile money payment tracking, and renter history whenever you need it.
replies.moveInContent:
Before moving in, landlords in Kigali typically ask for:

• Upfront monthly rent (often 1 to 3 months depending on the listing)
• A refundable security deposit (usually 1 month's rent)

Open any property page to inspect its specific move-in and monthly cost breakdown before requesting a visit.
replies.visitContent: You can browse all public properties on Urugo without creating an account. When you find a home you like, open its details page and choose Request a visit or Send an inquiry to reach the landlord directly.
